paragraphs.text: Flying carpets are artifacts commonly found on Rabiah .

It is said that only planeswalkers may create flying carpets with relative ease. Lesser magic workers must spend endless hours weaving together the delicate strands and complicated patterns that tie the magic of flight to these valuable objects. Most flying carpets are one adult arm-span wide by two arm-spans long and can support only one person. However, there are rumors of ancient carpets capable of carrying objects as large as a bull elephant .
